answer:
- **Immediate deletion:** Do not promise physical data deletion or sign a custom deletion SLA without consulting Priya Raman (Security and Governance Lead) and going through formal legal review [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. Under the standard policy, data is immediately removed from active access but physically purged within 90 days after termination [NL-019#NL-019-S05]. If a faster window is required, an Enterprise DPA exception can be negotiated in writing — e.g., 30-day active purge and 60-day backup purge — because faster backup deletion is technically impossible [NL-019#NL-019-S05]. Verbal or informal commitments should not be relied on [NL-019#NL-019-S05].

- **Teams availability:** Do not guarantee launch dates. The Microsoft Teams integration is in the planning/design phase for Q4 2026 and should be framed as a target, not a contractual commitment [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. Consult Sofia Almeida or the official Product Roadmap rather than relying on informal discussion [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. Also avoid telling prospects the integration is “almost ready”; that creates expectation gaps, and insecure alpha/custom builds are not released [NL-027#NL-027-S04].

- **Custom pricing:** Do not offer custom discounts on the Starter or Growth plans; any discount requires Marcus Reed’s approval and must align with the current pricing sheet (NL-003) [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. Deprecated 2025 rates must not be used in active proposals [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. Enterprise pricing starts at $8,500/month and is subject to security review, seat count, and integration requirements; do not quote final Enterprise pricing on discovery calls [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. New negotiations must use the current 2026 pricing schedule exclusively [NL-004#NL-004-S05].
